rationale: The stock has already crashed ~22% on fundamental concerns (massive cash burn, poor earnings quality), and price is sitting at 20% of today's range with elevated relative volume — the initial panic selling may be exhausting but there is no clear technical confirmation of either a reversal or continuation. The spread is wide at 23 bps, the stock is highly volatile intraday (ATR ~$0.19 on 5m bars against a $12.93 price), and the news-driven selling creates unpredictable continuation risk; with today's realized loss already at -$84 and no clear edge in either direction, the risk/reward does not justify a position.
